div.h3: Effortless Date Range Management with Smart Logic & Overlap Protection

div.p: Managing date ranges for sequences (Invoices, SO, PO) can be a nightmare when done manually. One mistake in dates can lead to duplicate or broken sequence numbers.
Subsequence Generator automates this process. Generate monthly, weekly, or daily ranges in seconds with built-in intelligence to handle your numbering logic perfectly.

div.style: background: linear-gradient(135deg, #875A7B 0%, #6c4762 100%); padding: 40px; border-radius: 15px; color: white; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
div.p: System detects 'today' and continues your current sequence, while future ranges start fresh from number 1 automatically.

div.p: Generate dozens of subsequences for an entire year in one click. Support for Daily, Weekly, and Monthly intervals.

div.p: Sophisticated Overlap Detector logic identifies date conflicts in real-time, preventing sequence errors.

div.p: Conflicting ranges are highlighted in Red with clear alerts on the form view for immediate action.
Three simple steps to automate your workflow
Open any sequence and look for the "Generate Subsequences" button.
Set your date range and choose the interval (Daily/Weekly/Monthly).
The system creates all ranges and handles the Next Number logic for you.
We are ready to help you with customization or installation.
